dermatology.description: Used to treat skin conditions such as acne, infections, and inflammation.
dermatology.note: Avoid excessive use; follow application instructions.

neuro_musculo.description: Used for neurological conditions, psychiatric disorders, muscle pain, and joint inflammation.
neuro_musculo.note: May cause drowsiness; do not stop abruptly without medical advice.

hormones_oncology.description: Used for hormonal regulation, reproductive health, cancer treatment, and specialty medical procedures.
hormones_oncology.note: Requires strict medical supervision; may have significant side effects.

diabetes_endocrine.description: Used to control blood sugar levels and treat endocrine disorders.
diabetes_endocrine.note: Monitor glucose regularly; follow diet recommendations.

cardiovascular_blood.description: Used to manage heart conditions and blood-related disorders such as hypertension and cholesterol.
cardiovascular_blood.note: Regular monitoring is important; follow dosage strictly.

analgesics_pain_fever.description: Used to relieve pain and reduce fever.
analgesics_pain_fever.note: Do not exceed recommended dose; risk of liver damage if overused.

respiratory_digestive.description: Used to treat respiratory conditions such as cough and asthma, and digestive disorders such as acidity and nausea.
respiratory_digestive.note: Some may cause drowsiness; take digestive medications as directed around meals.

infections_immunity.description: Used to treat bacterial, fungal, and microbial infections, and to support immune function.
infections_immunity.note: Complete the full course; do not misuse or overuse antibiotics.

steroids_topicals.description: Topical medications used to reduce inflammation and treat skin conditions like eczema and rashes.
steroids_topicals.note: Avoid prolonged use; apply only to affected areas.

eye_ear_nose_preparations.description: Used to treat infections and conditions related to eyes, ears, and nose.
eye_ear_nose_preparations.note: Use hygienically; avoid contamination of applicators.

vitamins_supplements.description: Used to support general health and treat vitamin or mineral deficiencies.
vitamins_supplements.note: Not a substitute for a balanced diet.
